MEASURED on two real Venus D units (BMS 118, Micro 116, Control 151): the register reads 5 on both although LAN works (both units have a LAN address); the CH395 version register 45605 (direct SPI read) returned 0x4A (74) on one unit (the one-pack unit; 45605 was not read on the other). Board_PeripheralSelfTest (0x0801dcf4) sets stage 5 when the CH395 version byte is not 0x4B ('K') or when the XFMC SRAM sub-test fails (the second part of the CH395 condition, the result after CH395_Debug_SendCmdByte(0xFE) == 1, is unclear in the decompilation); the SRAM works (the Control uses it constantly), so the failing part is the chip-version comparison (0x4A != 0x4B alone explains stage 5). Stage 5 with a working LAN is therefore harmless (chip revision 0x4A instead of 0x4B); real faults are 2 (EEPROM) and 3 (flash).

name: wifi_ssid_00
schreibeffekt: Stores 2 ASCII bytes of the 32-byte SSID buffer (bytes 0-1; high byte = first char). Any value accepted, never returns an exception. RAM only; no trigger, no EEPROM, no Wi-Fi action by itself. Buffer is NOT cleared first - stale tail bytes stay unless a 0x00 terminator is written.
beweisstand_D: bewiesen (Code aller beteiligten, vorhandenen Geräte geprüft)
einheit_skala_D: 2 ASCII chars per register, big-endian; SSID 1..31 chars + 0x00 terminator (32 chars overrun into the password buffer via strlen)
ziel_D: FC41D: FC41D Wi-Fi STA config (AT+QSTAAPINFODEF), Control EEPROM 0x400 on success - only via the password commit
leseeffekt_D: Returns the 2 current buffer bytes (the configured SSID as loaded from EEPROM 0x400 at boot, or whatever was last written / reloaded). Leaks the SSID (not secret, but privacy-relevant).
befund_D: Takes effect only when a later 41600..41631 write commits (low byte 0 or reg 41631). Without a commit the value just sits in RAM and is overwritten by the auto-connect EEPROM reload (only while Wi-Fi is down) or on reboot.
gefahr_D: low: alone harmless; as part of a commit it can disconnect Wi-Fi/cloud (Modbus TCP runs over CH395 Ethernet and RS485 are unaffected)
suite_empfehlung_D: Do not expose as entities. Use only inside an optional write-only 'set Wi-Fi' service (advanced/DEV). An SSID read-back diagnostic sensor is possible but privacy-sensitive; disabled by default if at all.
